text: What #790's reviews found outside the files its plan names, done in #895. The layer that writes refuses what the factory's checks refuse, whoever calls it. Proposal.Write refuses a module name that isn't one and an amended project's module path that leaves the project, and the factory's check of them is Write's own. Lock.Write refuses an acceptance test file's path that climbs out of its checkout before it writes anything, and writes through the checkout's own root, which follows no link out of it. Ratification asks the worktree's root the same about a project's directory: a link a person committed on the base branch, on the way to the directory or inside it, that leads out of the repository is refused in a note that says to remove it, where the second review's probe had a whole project written into the link's target. A link that stays inside the repository is left alone. A build holds its ratified post's own branch and project to what ratification writes there, one of its issue's branches and a directory an issue could name or the issue's own plan, before it checks anything out, and one that isn't is a failed build that says so. A plan's build asks again after a failed read of its issue's posts, as a modeled build does since #799. A plan's lock that meets a link leaves its ratification pending with the reason in the watcher's log, since a failed write can't be told from a moment's trouble with the disk.
